Reverse Grapple.name: Reverse Grapple
Reverse Grapple.description: The character can execute brawling specialization attacks while grappling/grappled. As part of a core action utilizing their brawling, they can attempt to reverse a grapple they're caught within. The character initiates a grapple check. On success, they choose between escaping or grappling the target. This action can only be taken once each round.

Disarming Attack.name: Disarming Attack
Disarming Attack.description: The next successful strike this turn knocks whatever the target is holding in their hands 10' away in a direction of the character's choosing.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn knocks whatever the target is holding in their hands 10' away in a direction of the target's choice.

Disorienting Strike.name: Disorienting Strike
Disorienting Strike.description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose their reaction until the end of their next turn. If the target is a size category larger than the character, WIL save to negate.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose their reaction until the end of their next turn. If the target is a size category larger than the character, WIL save to negate.
skillStats.condition: If the target is a size category larger than the character

Grappling Attack.name: Grappling Attack
Grappling Attack.description: The next successful strike this turn automatically grapples the target.

Grappled.name: Grappled
Grappled.description: A grapple can be made with a successful melee attack roll, (inflicting no damage, though skill can alter grapples) pinning them on hit. The target is reduced to a core action (while grappled), and the grappler is slowed. The target regains their movement and swift action upon breaking the grapple. To maintain a grapple the character must spend a Core Action each round.\nIt takes two arms to grapple a target of the character’s own size class, one arm to grapple a target of a smaller size class, and the character cannot effectively grapple a target of a larger size class.\nGrappled targets can attempt to break by using a core action to attempt a new grapple check (contested might check.)

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn automatically grapples the target.

Knockout.name: Knockout
Knockout.description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose a core action until the end of their next turn, or instead be knocked unconscious if they are below half their maximum HP, their choice of a WIL or HEA save to negate either effect. If the target is of a similar size or smaller in comparison to the character and grappled, they cannot resist the effect.

Depleted.name: Depleted
Depleted.description: the character loses their core action. or 2 action points if they are a rogue or have special action economies.

Unconcious.name: Unconcious
Unconcious.description: Unconscious targets have a number of distinctions:\nCannot perform any kind of actions and automatically fail all AGI and STR checks.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn automatically grapples the target.
skillStats.condition: If  the target is  below  half  their  maximum  HP

Launch.name: Launch
Launch.description: The character executes an action, launching themselves or another target 20' per rank in any direction, AGI or STR save (target's choice) to negate. If the target is of a similar size or smaller in comparison to the character and grappled, they cannot resist the effect. This ability requires a suitable surface to push off of if used on oneself.

Lethal Barrage II.name: Lethal Barrage II
Lethal Barrage II.description: For every rank purchased, the character adds 2 damage to all successful strikes this turn.
